task_message:
Case M11: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 440x440x210 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case M11 is complete.

**Summary:** The myxoid soft-tissue tumor was identified as the large, lobulated, markedly T2-hyperintense mass in the right anterior abdominal wall. A single point prompt inside its bright core produced a mask of 81.4 mL (roughly 69 × 51 × 53 mm) that follows the lesion's lobulated contour and internal septations in the axial, coronal and sagittal planes. Verification views at the superior/inferior, anterior/posterior and medial/lateral extremes showed no lesion tissue beyond the mask and no leakage into adjacent muscle, fat or bladder. The two automatic candidate proposals lay adjacent to the mass but were thin, smooth, tubular and homogeneous — consistent with perifascial vessels rather than tumor extension — so they were rejected. Final mask saved: 1 connected component, 81.4 mL, confidence medium.
